critic.fix_suggestion: For the 'Main deck window row' and 'Upper deck window row' primitive arrays, modify the spacing parameter from a clustered distribution to a uniform linear distribution. Set the distance between each window center point to 15% of the total fuselage length (Z-axis), ensuring even distribution across the mid-fuselage section while maintaining current dimensions for individual windows.

discrepancies.observed: A single continuous line of small dots along the fuselage side.
discrepancies.reference: Two distinct rows of windows (main deck and upper deck) with specific spacing.

discrepancies.observed: The upper deck has a very short, sparse row of windows near the nose.
discrepancies.reference: A long, continuous row of windows extending significantly back from the cockpit.

discrepancies.observed: No visible door frames or structural breaks in the fuselage skin.
discrepancies.reference: Clearly defined main cabin doors and emergency exits with distinct rectangular outlines.

discrepancies.observed: Windows are clustered tightly near the front and rear of the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: Windows are evenly spaced along the majority of the mid-fuselage length.
